arguments.name: operation
arguments.description: Git operation to run in the repository.

arguments.name: repository
arguments.description: Local Git working copy the operation runs in.

arguments.name: paths
arguments.description: Paths to stage for the 'add' operation (the whole repository, '.', when omitted).

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: Commit message; required for the 'commit' operation.

arguments.name: tag
arguments.description: Release tag committed as 'Deployment - <tag>'; required for the 'deployment' operation.

arguments.name: count
arguments.description: Number of commits shown by the 'log' operation.

arguments.name: reference
arguments.description: Branch or revision to check out; required for the 'checkout' operation.

outputs.name: repository
outputs.description: Repository path the operation ran in.

outputs.name: stdout
outputs.description: Standard output of git pull, fetch or push.

outputs.name: stderr
outputs.description: Standard error of git pull, fetch or push.

outputs.name: paths
outputs.description: Paths that were staged (add, revision and deployment operations).

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Commit message used (commit, revision and deployment operations).

outputs.name: nothing_to_commit
outputs.description: True when there were no changes to commit.

outputs.name: reference
outputs.description: Branch or revision checked out (checkout operation).
